estimates.basis: Official minimum and recommended RAM for a standard Immich installation

review.workload: Standard Immich installation with normal uploads and background processing
review.explanation: Immich publishes a 6 GB minimum and recommends 8 GB. This range records those two endpoints without estimating storage for the photo library.

review.workload: Basic Pi-hole installation on a supported operating system
review.explanation: Pi-hole publishes a 512 MB RAM requirement. No broader official operating range is given, so both endpoints use that requirement.

estimates.basis: Official minimum and recommended free space for Pi-hole

review.workload: Basic Pi-hole installation on a supported operating system
review.explanation: Pi-hole publishes 2 GB of free space as the minimum and recommends 4 GB.
